observations: The complete North/South island chain and accompanying islands remain recognizable in matched projection and extent.
Modern coast detail is greater than the raw Natural Earth reference, especially the western and southern coastal island groups; no new simplification is imposed on the approved donor.
The water-only perimeter separates the complete selected archipelago from Vaigach, Yamal/mainland and other Arctic groups.
All 757 modern components are included even where too small to distinguish at nominal 1:10M; completeness is established by the exact ledger, never by visibility.
No shared political mainland boundary is touched. The paired 1922 parent/constituent receive the identical complete group.
limits: Nominal 1:10M at 300 dpi, not physical-screen calibrated.
No independent historical coast-position or glacier-front validation; modern physical-coast approximation retains original qualifications.
